ai_summary: AAVAS Financiers Limited has received crucial Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approval for Mr. Manu Yeshpal Singh's appointment as Managing Director for a five-year tenure, significantly progressing the formalization of its executive leadership. While this clears a major regulatory hurdle, it is notable that Board of Directors' approval is still pending, representing an atypical procedural order after receiving regulatory clearance for the role.
